verdicts.rationale: The coverage check found no public API or developer page, the integrations page (c3, c4) lists only built-in connectors, and the in-account 'Integration' or 'API' section in c5 holds a portal embed snippet rather than an API for reading or changing records.
verdicts.missing: Any API documentation, public or behind a login, for reading or changing investors, entities, distributions, capital calls or other core records.

verdicts.rationale: Nothing in the pack mentions an MCP server for Covercy.
verdicts.missing: Any official MCP server, its documentation or its setup steps.

verdicts.rationale: Nothing in the pack shows an official SDK, CLI, code samples or public code repository for Covercy.
verdicts.missing: Any vendor-maintained SDK or CLI on a public package registry or repository, or even code samples.

verdicts.rationale: No webhook or event documentation appears, c4's integrations page is noted as having no API or webhook page, and c3's automatic syncs are built-in connectors rather than events an agent can subscribe to.
verdicts.missing: Any webhooks, event subscriptions or third-party automation-platform triggers for Covercy records.

verdicts.rationale: The pack shows no API keys, tokens or OAuth clients, let alone scopes or roles that limit them.
verdicts.missing: Any API credentials an agent could obtain, and any documented scopes, roles or permissions for them.

verdicts.rationale: The pack shows no OpenAPI, Swagger, GraphQL or other machine-readable API specification, and no public API to describe.
verdicts.missing: Any machine-readable API description, public or behind a login.

verdicts.rationale: The probe confirms an llms.txt file exists (GET 200, 9511 bytes), but c7 shows it lists marketing and product pages rather than the documentation.
verdicts.missing: Whether the llms.txt covers the Help Center documentation at help.covercy.com, and whether any documentation pages are published as Markdown.

verdicts.rationale: Nothing in the pack shows a sandbox, test mode or developer environment for Covercy.
verdicts.missing: Any developer sandbox or test environment, self-serve or on request; the 14-day product trial is not shown to be a developer environment.

verdicts.rationale: Nothing in the pack mentions exporting or downloading records in bulk in CSV, JSON, Excel or another open format.
verdicts.missing: Any documented self-serve export of investor, entity, transaction or report data and its formats; the automatic syncs to QuickBooks, Rent Manager and Yardi are not shown to be exports.

verdicts.rationale: The public pricing page offers a 'Start 14-day Trial' button as an alternative to 'Talk to sales', showing a trial a sponsor can start from the page without a sales call.
verdicts.missing: The trial sign-up flow itself (whether it is free and needs no call, card or approval) and whether the trial is offered on the Standard and Professional tiers as well as Fundraising Starter.

verdicts.rationale: The public pricing page prices plans per legal entity, showing Fundraising Starter at $249 per entity per month ($498 per month at two entities) and listing Standard at $566 and Professional at $812 per month.
verdicts.missing: Prices are shown only at the two-entity setting, and the pack does not show whether onboarding, payment-processing or other fees apply.

verdicts.rationale: The pack shows no API, so there is no documented way to create investor records or send subscription documents through one.
verdicts.missing: Any API endpoint or documentation for creating investors or starting subscription documents, directly or through a third-party integration.

verdicts.rationale: Nothing in the pack shows an API for creating or reading distributions or for generating investor notices.
verdicts.missing: Any API documentation for posting distributions or generating or sending distribution notices.

verdicts.rationale: Nothing in the pack shows API endpoints or a documented export that returns investors, commitments and contributions as JSON or CSV.
verdicts.missing: Any API or documented export of the investor register, even a manual in-app one; the investor portal's Cash Flows page is shown only as an on-screen view.

verdicts.rationale: Nothing in the pack shows an API for issuing capital calls or reading each investor's funding status.
verdicts.missing: Any API documentation for creating capital calls or reading funding status; the changelog shows funding status only in the investor portal's Payment Due tile.
